registrationPrecheck.expectedVerdict: the shifted half must be reported as unqualified for difference, not as change

densityLoss.smearingNote: because epoch 2 also carries an injected 0.5 m x shift, points from the column beside a skipped cell are attributed into it under a nearest-cell read; the two counts differ by design, and that difference is exactly why the registration pre-check must run before any epoch difference is drawn

validDifferenceArea: epoch-1 cells that are present in epoch 2 and outside the shifted half
rule: a difference may only be published where the pre-check passed; elsewhere the answer is no-result, not no-change
